Sign in
All your assessment needs, in one easy place.

Phonics, maths, English and general knowledge – one tool for every check your school runs, instead of a different spreadsheet or app for each. Work through a check with a child sitting next to you, or set the class off on their own devices with a join code – then get results, trends and CSV exports without touching a spreadsheet.

Already have an account? Sign in Student? Enter your class code
What it does
Every subject, one place

Phonics, maths, English and topic checks all live in the same tool, with the same results and analytics behind them – no more juggling separate spreadsheets or apps per subject.

Phonics, screening-ready

Letters and Sounds Sets 1–3 and a Blending Check in the same format as the statutory Year 1 Phonics Screening Check, so you can track blending all year – not just in June.

Maths, well beyond times tables

Times tables, shape & geometry, weight & measure, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and place value – a full maths toolkit from Reception through to Year 6.

English & general knowledge, too

Grammar checks from KS1 to UKS2, plus topic checks starting with Ancient Egyptians – and you can request new topics or checks any time, straight from the app.

Live sessions for the whole class

Start a live session and children join with a code and work through the check on their own device, while you watch progress come in – ideal when you can't sit one-to-one with every child.

Results and analytics, done for you

Every check feeds live dashboards – most-missed sounds and questions, trends over time, and breakdowns by year group, gender and additional needs.

Export whenever you need it

One click gives you a CSV of every result – ready for pupil progress meetings, moderation, or your MIS.

Built for busy schools
Each school gets its own private, cloud-synced account – every staff member signs in separately but sees the whole school's data.
Nothing to install. Works in any browser, on any laptop, tablet or interactive whiteboard.
Results save instantly and sync across every device – no more chasing paper trackers.
Pricing
£30/year, per school

One flat fee for every subject. Unlimited staff logins, unlimited children, unlimited assessments.
